reason: This PR is a test reorganization only: it moves existing `expression/integration*` and `session/nontransactional` cases into `tests/integrationtest`, with accompanying `BUILD.bazel`, README, and testdata updates. There are no production-code changes in planner/executor/expression/session/sessionctx/statistics/kv/store/parser/table/privilege behavior, so the target modules are incidental test surfaces rather than the center of the PR.
